hypothesis: A maximally pure-function spec (zero I/O, zero lifecycle, zero HTTP, single file) ships end-to-end through the current pipeline. Previous plateaus were caused by scenario-surface complexity (subprocess/HTTP/lifecycle), not by an inherent SA-quality ceiling.

SHIP.definition: Oracle SHIP on iteration 1 or 2. All 3 Tier-1 contracts pass. >=6 of 8 Tier-2 ACs pass. Zero SCENARIO_CRASH classifications. Zero scenarios written to /tmp/ or spawning subprocesses.
SHIP.interpretation: Pipeline CAN ship pure-function specs. Plateau is surface-specific (HTTP/lifecycle). Proceed to 4.5b (lifecycle bridge) to localize the failure surface.

SHIP_SUSPECT.definition: Oracle SHIP but with >=1 SCENARIO_CRASH, OR scenarios written to /tmp/, OR SA-generated scenarios test something other than direct imports (HTTP/subprocess/fs).
SHIP_SUSPECT.interpretation: Pipeline shipped but by accident — SA is still emitting wrong-surface tests and Oracle/gate let them pass. Treat as PLATEAU for planning purposes; investigate why crashed scenarios didn't block.

PLATEAU.definition: Oracle ESCALATE / NO-SHIP after 2 iterations. Pass-rate < 80% on Tier-2 ACs. OR any iteration produces >=1 SCENARIO_CRASH or >=2 BRITTLE classifications on this pure-function spec.
PLATEAU.interpretation: The plateau is NOT surface-specific. SA quality is broken even on the simplest possible input. Prompt-tweaks are definitively ruled out. Escalate to 4.6b.2 (SA role split) immediately; skip 4.5b.

tripwires.cost_2x: If total_cost_usd > 2x the 2026-04-08-03-07 run ($X), abort and treat as PLATEAU regardless of outcome.

notes: This gate is committed BEFORE the measurement run. Outcome classification must match one of the three buckets exactly. No post-hoc redefinition. If the run produces something unanticipated, that IS the finding — document it and escalate to user before re-classifying.
